ruling: R34 (Drew, 2026-09-14, answering Q4): hockey pool rows on the bare `upper-deck` key are re-keyed to `upper-deck-series-1` for card numbers 1-250 and `upper-deck-series-2` for 251-500.
reportOnlyUntil: REPORT ONLY until a steward dispatches it. This file routes nothing by existing; the lane writes only under BACKFILL_APPLY=true. Dispatch SCOPE=data/pool-relocations/<this file>, one part at a time.
finding: 108,704 sold_comps rows across 6 years sit on the bare flagship key `upper-deck`, which holds ZERO checklist rows in every one of those years, while `upper-deck-series-1` and `upper-deck-series-2` are fully checklist-backed (8,124 / 5,925 rows in 2024 alone).
rulings: THE CARD NUMBER DECIDES, AND ONLY WHEN IT IS A NUMBER. Series 1 is 1-250, Series 2 is 251-500 — verified against the staged checklists, not assumed: both Series 1 files carry numeric cards 1-250 and nothing else; the Series 2 files carry 251-650.

501-650 IS EXCLUDED THOUGH THE SERIES 2 CHECKLIST CARRIES IT. Those 250-300 rows are the `O-Pee-Chee Update` subsets (601-650), whose own subset key is still unruled (Q2, deferred). Re-keying a pool row there would put it on an address no ruling has settled.

AND THE POOL'S 501+ ROWS ARE A THIRD PRODUCT. The undecided numeric rows measured at 720/744/746 are 2021-22 Upper Deck EXTENDED SERIES Young Guns — not Series 1 or 2. The 1-250/251-500 rule correctly excludes them; a wider range would have swept them onto the wrong product.

AN INSERT CODE CANNOT SAY WHICH SERIES, SO 37,236 ROWS (34.3%) ARE NOT IN THIS LIST. They carry a lettered code (#C94, #EC-4, #GXP-17) instead of a base number. The staged checklists CAN resolve most — of 226 insert-code prefixes in the 2021-22 pair, 129 are unique to Series 1, 88 to Series 2, only 9 appear in both — but that map needs BOTH series staged for a year, and only 2021 has both. Resolving 2019/2020/2022/2023/2024 against a single series file cannot see the ambiguity. Absent beats wrong.

THE LANE CANNOT EXPRESS THIS AS A PREDICATE, SO THE LIST RESOLVES IT PER ROW. relocate-pool-rows-by-list.cjs is id-based by design — 'a row not in the file is never touched, so this lane cannot widen by accident the way a WHERE setKey = ... sweep can'. It has no range condition. The range was applied at list-build time from each row's own card-number segment, and every verdict is reviewable in this diff.

TWO SHAPES, BECAUSE cardId IS NOT ALWAYS A SLUG. sold_comps is partitioned on /cardId, but for vendor rows cardId is an OPAQUE id and the setKey lives only in hobbyiqCardId. 2,610 rows carry a hiq-slug cardId and are RELOCATE (real partition move); 68,841 carry an opaque cardId and are REPOINT (hobbyiqCardId patched in place, no partition move, the #1941 address guard still runs). An earlier cut of this list rewrote segment 3 of every cardId and produced destination partitions like "1717748779939x489697709320306700:::upper-deck-series-1" — that build was discarded.

census.note: every count read from prod read-only on 2026-09-14, paged by (sport, year, setKey) slug prefix; no cross-partition COUNT was issued over sold_comps.
